units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 2:3:2">Y. Peah II, 17ᵃ</cite> top, v. <cite ref="K01391"><he>כָּתַשׁ</he></cite>.
Jud. XV, 19) המקום ההוא מ׳ שמו that place was named Makhtesh (Cavity); ib. מלמד שהביא לו וכ׳ it intimates that the Lord opened to him a spring from between his (the ass’) teeth (taking מ׳ as jaw).
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 7:8">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VII, 8</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q02154"><he>פֶּתִי</he></cite>. Pesik. Shek. p. 15ᵃ, v. <cite ref="H01163"><he>חֲמוֹר</he></cite>.
